description: Erection of a single storey rear extension following demolition of existing single storey rear extension, erection of a rear roof dormer extension, installation of three front roof lights and reinstatement of the second floor obscure glazed side window.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications:  PG01 P07A; PG01 P08A  Received:  31 August 2023 and PG01 P01; PG01 P02; PG01 P03; PG01 P04; PG01 P05; PG01 P06; PG01 P09; Unreferenced Location Plan  Received:  20 July 2023.

Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Condition : 3 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.
Condition : 4 - No additional windows, doors or other glazed openings shall be formed in the single storey rear extension and rear roof dormer extension hereby approved.
Condition : 5 - The reinstated second floor side window shall be obscure glazed and non-openable below 1.7 metres above finished floor level and be permanently retained as such.
Condition : 6 - The window(s) to be fitted on the front roof face of the dwelling shall be black-framed and traditional, conservation-style.
